no-restricted-syntax.message: Raw hex colour. Use a design-system colour token: var(--brand-primary), var(--text-secondary), var(--surface-card). See design-system/tokens/color.css.
Raw rgb()/rgba() colour. Use a design-system colour token via var(). Alpha washes already exist: --brand-tint, --text-muted, --focus-ring-wash.
Raw length. Use a token: --space-* for spacing, --control-h* for control heights, --radius-* for radii, --fs-* for type. Note 5/7/11/15px are real steps — do not snap to 8.
Raw duration or easing. The system has one curve and two durations: var(--ease-standard), var(--dur-fast), var(--dur-base).
Ad-hoc shadow. Four shadows exist and depth comes from nothing else: --shadow-hairline, --shadow-field, --shadow-card, --shadow-pop.
Flat surfaces only. No gradients, no glass, no backdrop blur.
Stock Tailwind palette class. Use the DS scale: bg-surface, bg-row-alt, text-body, text-ds-secondary, text-ds-muted, border-line, bg-brand, text-approved. See design-system/tailwind.css.
No bounce, no spring, no looping animation. Fades and short slides only, on var(--ease-standard).

patterns.message: antd is being removed from both apps. Use the design-system primitive: Switch, Button, Field, Tag from '@/design-system'.
Import primitives from '@/design-system', not from a component file directly.
Icon sets are not interchangeable here. Use <Icon name="..." /> from '@/design-system'.
